summary: The audit checks the 45 graduate units, the nine required courses taken for a letter grade, one concentration course, 12 units of HRP 399 thesis research and at least 6 units of listed electives (other electives your advisor and the program director approve are added by hand). MED 255 is needed only on an NIH or similar training grant. Checked by hand: the 3.0 average in graded courses, the course plan, thesis proposal and Collaborative Master's Plan, and the master's thesis. Transfer credit is not accepted.

7tYJhhg4.why: Overview. "Successful completion of all course requirements, with 45 units of health-policy-related coursework (minimum)" is the program's unit minimum; the proposals, plan and thesis are their own rules.

rRUhzoDP.why: "NOTE: All courses must be taken for a letter grade." Stated on the required courses, so set there rather than program-wide.

H7s8azFY.why: "Required only for students funded by NIH (or similar) training grants."

Zlj8KARz.why: "Additional approved elective courses (at least six units) to complete the program total of at least 45 units." Encoded on the Pre-approved Electives list (LI6YO4Et); the 45 units are the program's minimum.

LI6YO4Et.why: "Additional approved elective courses (at least six units)" from this list; "Other electives, consistent with the student's development plan, may be approved by the student's faculty advisor and the program director" are moved in.

mY2xrmSb.why: "Students must submit a Course Plan (Master's Program Proposal) ... Each student will submit a thesis proposal by the end of the first year ... Each student will submit a Collaborative Master's Plan by November 1st of their second year."

dwImkHaU.why: "Successful completion of Master's Thesis, with approval of the student's thesis committee"; "All committee members must read and approve the final thesis."

add.why: GPA: "Students must maintain an overall 3.0 (B) grade average or higher in graded courses."
